examples.hanzi: 周日我们一家人去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Zhōurì wǒmen yījiārén qù páshān.
examples.english: On Sunday our whole family goes hiking.

examples.hanzi: 这家店周日不营业。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zhōurì bù yíngyè.
examples.english: This shop is closed on Sundays.

examples.hanzi: 他在空军服役了八年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài kōngjūn fúyì le bā nián.
examples.english: He served in the air force for eight years.

examples.hanzi: 空军的飞机从头顶飞过。
examples.pinyin: Kōngjūn de fēijī cóng tóudǐng fēiguò.
examples.english: Air force planes flew overhead.

examples.hanzi: 这个办法使得工作更轻松了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ shǐde gōngzuò gèng qīngsōng le.
examples.english: This method has made the work easier.

examples.hanzi: 下雨使得比赛推迟了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàyǔ shǐde bǐsài tuīchí le.
examples.english: The rain caused the match to be postponed.

examples.hanzi: 我收到了一张朋友寄来的卡片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shōudào le yī zhāng péngyou jìlái de kǎpiàn.
examples.english: I received a card sent by a friend.

examples.hanzi: 请把名字写在这张卡片上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ míngzi xiě zài zhè zhāng kǎpiàn shàng.
examples.english: Please write your name on this card.

examples.hanzi: 我们没有去看脱衣舞表演。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen méiyǒu qù kàn tuōyīwǔ biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: We didn't go to see the striptease show.

examples.hanzi: 这家酒吧晚上有脱衣舞。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔbā wǎnshang yǒu tuōyīwǔ.
examples.english: This bar has a striptease act in the evening.

examples.hanzi: 健身对身体很有好处。
examples.pinyin: Jiànshēn duì shēntǐ hěn yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Working out is very good for your body.

examples.hanzi: 你多久健身一次？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duō jiǔ jiànshēn yí cì?
examples.english: How often do you work out?

examples.hanzi: 孩子和父母分离了好几年。
examples.pinyin: Háizi hé fùmǔ fēnlí le hǎo jǐ nián.
examples.english: The child was separated from his parents for several years.

examples.hanzi: 这个实验需要把两种液体分离。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shíyàn xūyào bǎ liǎng zhǒng yètǐ fēnlí.
examples.english: This experiment requires separating the two liquids.

examples.hanzi: 后门没锁，你可以直接进来。
examples.pinyin: Hòumén méi suǒ, nǐ kěyǐ zhíjiē jìnlái.
examples.english: The back door isn't locked, so you can come right in.

examples.hanzi: 他想走后门找份好工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zǒu hòumén zhǎo fèn hǎo gōngzuò.
examples.english: He wants to use connections to get a good job.

examples.hanzi: 我们一定能战胜这场疾病。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yídìng néng zhànshèng zhè chǎng jíbìng.
examples.english: We will certainly overcome this illness.

examples.hanzi: 他终于战胜了自己的恐惧。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú zhànshèng le zìjǐ de kǒngjù.
examples.english: He finally conquered his own fear.

examples.hanzi: 佛罗里达的冬天很暖和。
examples.pinyin: Fóluólǐdá de dōngtiān hěn nuǎnhuo.
examples.english: Winters in Florida are very warm.

examples.hanzi: 我表姐住在佛罗里达。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ biǎojiě zhù zài Fóluólǐdá.
examples.english: My cousin lives in Florida.

examples.hanzi: 他累得一进门就倒下了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lèi de yí jìnmén jiù dǎoxià le.
examples.english: He was so tired that he collapsed as soon as he came in.

examples.hanzi: 墙在大风中倒下了。
examples.pinyin: Qiáng zài dàfēng zhōng dǎoxià le.
examples.english: The wall fell over in the strong wind.

examples.hanzi: 请给我一杯橙子果汁。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi chéngzi guǒzhī.
examples.english: Please give me a glass of orange juice.

examples.hanzi: 小孩子不应该喝太多果汁。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo háizi bù yīnggāi hē tài duō guǒzhī.
examples.english: Kids shouldn't drink too much fruit juice.

examples.hanzi: 他被迫放弃了这次机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèipò fàngqì le zhè cì jīhuì.
examples.english: He was forced to give up this opportunity.

examples.hanzi: 大雪让航班被迫取消。
examples.pinyin: Dàxuě ràng hángbān bèipò qǔxiāo.
examples.english: The heavy snow forced the flight to be cancelled.

examples.hanzi: 这条毛巾太小了，再拿一条吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo máojīn tài xiǎo le, zài ná yì tiáo ba.
examples.english: This towel is too small, so get another one.

examples.hanzi: 游泳后请用干毛巾擦干身体。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyǒng hòu qǐng yòng gān máojīn cā gān shēntǐ.
examples.english: After swimming, please dry off with a dry towel.

examples.hanzi: 这是一款大众都买得起的车。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yì kuǎn dàzhòng dōu mǎi de qǐ de chē.
examples.english: This is a car that ordinary people can afford.

examples.hanzi: 大众传媒影响着我们的生活。
examples.pinyin: Dàzhòng chuánmèi yǐngxiǎng zhe wǒmen de shēnghuó.
examples.english: The mass media affects our daily lives.

examples.hanzi: 比赛结束后，球迷们尽情狂欢。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéshù hòu, qiúmímen jìnqíng kuánghuān.
examples.english: After the game, the fans partied to their hearts' content.

examples.hanzi: 大家在广场上狂欢了一整夜。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā zài guǎngchǎng shàng kuánghuān le yì zhěng yè.
examples.english: Everyone celebrated in the square all night long.

examples.hanzi: 这顿饭是我亲手做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dùn fàn shì wǒ qīnshǒu zuò de.
examples.english: I cooked this meal with my own hands.

examples.hanzi: 他亲手把礼物交给了妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Tā qīnshǒu bǎ lǐwù jiāo gěi le mèimei.
examples.english: He handed the gift to his sister personally.

examples.hanzi: 一个人住在外地，有时会觉得寂寞。
examples.pinyin: Yí ge rén zhù zài wàidì, yǒushí huì juéde jìmò.
examples.english: Living alone in another city, you sometimes feel lonely.

examples.hanzi: 夜深了，街上显得很寂寞。
examples.pinyin: Yè shēn le, jiē shàng xiǎnde hěn jìmò.
examples.english: It was late at night and the street looked deserted.

examples.hanzi: 她的未婚夫是一名医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wèihūnfū shì yì míng yīshēng.
examples.english: Her fiancé is a doctor.

examples.hanzi: 我还没见过她的未婚夫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi jiànguo tā de wèihūnfū.
examples.english: I haven't met her fiancé yet.

examples.hanzi: 请及时清除电脑里的垃圾文件。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jíshí qīngchú diànnǎo lǐ de lājī wénjiàn.
examples.english: Please clear the junk files off your computer promptly.

examples.hanzi: 他想清除脸上的污渍。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qīngchú liǎn shàng de wūzì.
examples.english: He wants to remove the stains from his face.

examples.hanzi: 我们要尊重别人的尊严。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zūnzhòng biéren de zūnyán.
examples.english: We should respect other people's dignity.

examples.hanzi: 他不想为了钱而失去尊严。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng wèile qián ér shīqù zūnyán.
examples.english: He doesn't want to lose his dignity for money.

examples.hanzi: 别在我面前演戏了，我都看出来了。
examples.pinyin: Bié zài wǒ miànqián yǎnxì le, wǒ dōu kàn chūlái le.
examples.english: Stop putting on an act in front of me, I can already tell.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē háizi zhèngzài tái shàng yǎnxì.
examples.english: The children are performing a play on the stage.

examples.hanzi: 请打开手机的定位，我来找你。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dǎkāi shǒujī de dìngwèi, wǒ lái zhǎo nǐ.
examples.english: Please turn on your phone's location, and I'll come find you.

examples.hanzi: 这个品牌的定位是年轻人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái de dìngwèi shì niánqīngrén.
examples.english: This brand's positioning targets young people.

examples.hanzi: 没准他已经到家了。
examples.pinyin: Méizhǔn tā yǐjīng dào jiā le.
examples.english: He may well already be home.

examples.hanzi: 你先带把伞吧，没准会下雨。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān dài bǎ sǎn ba, méizhǔn huì xiàyǔ.
examples.english: Take an umbrella just in case, it might rain.

examples.hanzi: 这台电脑的芯片很先进。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo de xīnpiàn hěn xiānjìn.
examples.english: This computer's chip is very advanced.

examples.hanzi: 工厂正在生产新型芯片。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng zhèngzài shēngchǎn xīnxíng xīnpiàn.
examples.english: The factory is producing a new type of chip.

examples.hanzi: 核弹的威力非常巨大。
examples.pinyin: Hédàn de wēilì fēicháng jùdà.
examples.english: The power of a nuclear bomb is enormous.

examples.hanzi: 博物馆里展出了一枚核弹模型。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ zhǎnchū le yì méi hédàn móxíng.
examples.english: A model of a nuclear bomb is on display in the museum.

examples.hanzi: 请填写你的姓名和工作单位。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng tiánxiě nǐ de xìngmíng hé gōngzuò dānwèi.
examples.english: Please fill in your name and place of work.

examples.hanzi: 米是长度的单位。
examples.pinyin: Mǐ shì chángdù de dānwèi.
examples.english: The meter is a unit of length.

examples.hanzi: 这台旧收音机还能用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù shōuyīnjī hái néng yòng.
examples.english: This old radio still works.

examples.pinyin: Kāichē de shíhou tā xǐhuan tīng shōuyīnjī.
examples.english: He likes listening to the radio while driving.

examples.english: The police cuffed his hands with handcuffs.

examples.english: In the movie, the thief was led away in handcuffs.

examples.english: I want to see a show on Broadway in New York.

examples.hanzi: 百老汇的剧院总是座无虚席。
examples.pinyin: Bǎilǎohuì de jùyuàn zǒngshì zuò wú xū xí.
examples.english: The theaters on Broadway are always packed.

examples.pinyin: Liǎng zhī duìwu zài shānqū zuòzhàn.
examples.english: The two armies are fighting in the mountains.

examples.pinyin: Tuánduì hézuò bǐ dāndú zuòzhàn gèng yǒuxiào.
examples.english: Teamwork is more effective than fighting alone.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen xià zhōu jiāo lùnwén.
examples.english: The teacher wants us to hand in our papers next week.

examples.hanzi: 这篇论文讨论了环境污染的问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān lùnwén tǎolùn le huánjìng wūrǎn de wèntí.
examples.english: This paper discusses the problem of environmental pollution.

examples.english: Grandpa's will is kept in the drawer.

examples.pinyin: Tā qǐng lǜshī bāngmáng xiě yízhǔ.
examples.english: He asked a lawyer to help him write a will.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de jiàgé duì píngmín lái shuō hěn héshì.
examples.english: This restaurant's prices are reasonable for ordinary people.

examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòzhě de xīn shū xià ge yuè chūbǎn.
examples.english: This author's new book comes out next month.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zhè shǒu gē de zuòzhě shì shéi ma?
examples.english: Do you know who the author of this song is?

examples.pinyin: Duōkuī nǐ tíxǐng wǒ, bùrán wǒ jiù wàng le.
examples.english: Thanks to your reminder, I would have forgotten otherwise.

examples.pinyin: Duōkuī dài le sǎn, wǒmen cái méi bèi línshī.
examples.english: Luckily we brought an umbrella, so we didn't get soaked.

examples.english: My weight has gone up three kilograms recently.

examples.english: Please walk forward fifty meters and then turn right.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào kànzhe wèilái, jìxù xiàng qián.
examples.english: We should look to the future and keep moving forward.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen shì yí duì xìngfú de bànlǚ.
examples.english: They are a happy couple.

examples.hanzi: 狗是很多老人的伴侣。
examples.pinyin: Gǒu shì hěn duō lǎorén de bànlǚ.
examples.english: For many elderly people, a dog is a companion.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngnián xiǎng qù Bāxī kàn zúqiú bǐsài.
examples.english: Next year I want to go to Brazil to watch a soccer match.

examples.hanzi: 他在巴西住了三年，会说葡萄牙语。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Bāxī zhù le sān nián, huì shuō Pútáoyáyǔ.
examples.english: He lived in Brazil for three years and speaks Portuguese.

examples.hanzi: 我有一种不好的预感。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yì zhǒng bù hǎo de yùgǎn.
examples.english: I have a bad feeling about this.

examples.pinyin: Tā yùgǎn dào zhè cì kǎoshì huì hěn nán.
examples.english: He had a premonition that this exam would be hard.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de shàngbān shíjiān shì gùdìng de.
examples.english: Our working hours are fixed.

examples.hanzi: 请把桌子固定好，不要让它晃动。

examples.english: Please secure the table so that it doesn't wobble.

examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de kǒuwèi yǒudiǎnr zhòng.
examples.english: This dish tastes a bit strong.

examples.pinyin: Bīngqílín yǒu hěn duō zhǒng kǒuwèi.
examples.english: Ice cream comes in many flavors.

examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù gōngyuán duànliàn.
examples.english: He exercises in the park every morning.

examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò néng duànliàn nǐ de gōutōng nénglì.
examples.english: This job can sharpen your communication skills.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, sǎngzi hěn téng.
examples.english: I've caught a cold and my throat hurts.

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn lěng, hěn duō rén gǎnmào le.
examples.english: The weather turned cold and many people caught colds.

examples.hanzi: 小朋友，请排好队。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou, qǐng pái hǎo duì.
examples.english: Kids, please line up.

examples.hanzi: 幼儿园的小朋友在唱歌。
examples.pinyin: Yòu'éryuán de xiǎopéngyou zài chànggē.
examples.english: The kindergarten kids are singing.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng xiān zhùcè yí ge zhànghào zài dēnglù.
examples.english: Please register an account before logging in.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhùcè le zhè mén kè ma?
examples.english: Have you enrolled in this course?

examples.pinyin: Zhège cūnzi zāoshòu le yánzhòng de gānhàn.
examples.english: This village suffered a severe drought.

examples.hanzi: 他在比赛中遭受了失败。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng zāoshòu le shībài.
examples.english: He suffered a defeat in the competition.

examples.pinyin: Jiǎnchá jiéguǒ xiǎnshì, nà zhǐshì yí ge xiǎo zhǒngliú.
examples.english: The results showed it was only a small tumor.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì jǐnzǎo qiēchú zhǒngliú.
examples.english: The doctor advised removing the tumor as early as possible.

examples.hanzi: 这朵花的气味很特别。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duǒ huā de qìwèi hěn tèbié.
examples.english: This flower has a very special scent.

examples.hanzi: 房间里有一股烟的气味。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu yì gǔ yān de qìwèi.
examples.english: There is a smell of smoke in the room.
